reverse_edges.Tempus AI -> Recursion: Tempus licenses de-identified multimodal oncology data to Recursion (the existing Recursion -> Tempus AI edge is the TxFM model licence flowing the other way)

players.product: multimodal clinical data, diagnostics, and AI applications

connects_to.relationship: licenses de-identified multimodal oncology data and access to its clinical / molecular database to Recursion

contracts.signal: Supplier Tempus AI (data license to Recursion): Recursion's 8-K (Item 1.01): on September 15, 2026 Recursion amended its November 3, 2023 Master Agreement with Tempus, which had a five-year term terminable for convenience after three years and Annual License Fees of $22,000,000 (first anniversary), $32,000,000 (second anniversary) and $42,000,000 (each of the third and fourth anniversaries), payable 100% in Recursion shares at its election. The amendment extends the term from five to six years, eliminates Recursion's right to terminate for convenience, revises the Annual License Fees payable by Recursion to $14,000,000 on each of the third, fourth and fifth anniversaries (at least $4,000,000 in cash, the remainder in shares, cash or both at Recursion's election), and decreases the aggregate total of unique de-identified data records Recursion may access.
contracts.units: term extended from five to six years; fewer unique de-identified data records accessible
contracts.value: $14,000,000 Annual License Fee on each of the third, fourth and fifth anniversaries (at least $4,000,000 in cash)
